jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer – Patrol & Safety
jobs.description:
Texas Health Resources is seeking a full-time Security Officer in Plano, Texas, to patrol buildings and enforce security policies. Ideal candidates will have at least 2 years of security experience, a high school diploma, and must possess a Class C Driver's License.

Benefits include 401k, PTO, and tuition reimbursement, along with a supportive team environment that emphasizes high-quality patient care.

jobs.title: On-Call Hospital Security Officer
jobs.description:
Phoebe Putney Health System is seeking a security professional to safeguard patients, staff and visitors across the Fort Worth area. This role emphasizes patrols, access control, and rapid response to incidents across hospital properties.

The position requires diligent observation, quick assessment and effective communication, with duties including coordinating with authorities, assisting in restraint procedures, and maintaining safety for all occupants in non-clinical environments.

jobs.title: Hospital Public Safety Officer with Sign-On Bonus
jobs.description: Baylor Scott & White Health is looking for a dedicated Police Officer for the Public Safety Department in Dallas, Texas. The role requires patrolling hospital grounds, responding to emergencies, and conducting investigations to ensure safety and security. Candidates need a high school diploma and must complete certifications within specified periods. The benefits include health coverage, a 401(k) plan, and tuition reimbursement. Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits is provided, alongside PTO from day one.

jobs.title: Part-Time Lead Hospital Officer (Detainee Care & Security)
jobs.description:
The GEO Group, Inc. is seeking a Lead Hospital Officer to supervise detainees in hospital settings, ensuring custody and compliance with hospital protocols and medical procedures.

The role requires overseeing restraint use, safeguarding detainees, and maintaining accurate documentation. Required are a high school diploma, 3 years in law enforcement with lead experience, a State Firearms License, a State Security Guard License, and completion of GEO’s supervision training or equivalent

Candidates must possess an Associate's degree or equivalent experience and be ready to obtain necessary certifications within specified timelines. #J-18808-Ljbffr Baylor Scott & White Health
